clusters.headline: Israel President Herzog Tasks Gadi Eisenkot With Forming Government
aiSummaryBullets: President Isaac Herzog selected opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot to form a new Israeli government following the recent national election.
The decision follows an October 27 election where no candidate secured an immediate parliamentary majority.

clusters.headline: Israeli President Tasks Gadi Eisenkot With Forming New Government
aiSummaryBullets: President Isaac Herzog has formally invited Gadi Eisenkot to assemble a new governing administration.
The appointment creates the possibility that Prime Minister Binyamin Netanyahu’s tenure will conclude in the coming weeks.
